title: Chapter 06 — Market Outcomes
desc: Consumer and producer surplus, why the competitive equilibrium maximises total surplus, and what price ceilings and floors destroy.
intro: Chapter 4 found the equilibrium; this one asks whether it was any good. Two triangles turn the diagram into a measure of value created — and then show exactly how much a well-meant price control burns.
